info.title: BazaarSentinel API
info.description: Multi-tenant SaaS for marketplace listing monitoring. Watch products on online bazaars (e.g., Revolico) and get notified when any user-configured alarm condition matches — price drops/rises, view-count thresholds, seller changes, outstanding status.

condition.description: Condition type that triggers the alarm

storeKey.description: Logical key identifying the scraping target

expression.description: JSONata expression evaluated against the scraped DOM tree

enabled.description: Whether the worker should use this row

storeKey.description: Logical key identifying the scraping target (must be unique)

deepLink.description: One-time deep link URL for the bot

expiresAt.description: ISO timestamp when the link expires

post.summary: Register a new user with local credentials
post.description: Creates a user account with email/password authentication within an existing account.

post.summary: Register or login with an OAuth provider
post.description: Authenticates a user via OAuth provider (google, facebook). Creates the user if they do not exist.

get.summary: List users in the current tenant
List all alarms in the current tenant
List all notifications in the current tenant

post.description: Enqueues a background job to scrape products from Revolico. Requires SUPER_ADMIN role.
Persists a new JSONata expression under a unique storeKey. SUPER_ADMIN only.

get.description: Returns every row (enabled and disabled), sorted by storeKey.

put.description: Replaces the expression and invalidates the worker registry cache.

post.summary: Generate a one-time deep link token for bot account linking
post.description: Creates a signed JWT link token and provider-specific deep link URLs. The token expires in 5 minutes. One click on the deep link completes the link — no manual code entry.

requestBody.description: User ID and optional provider hint

get.summary: Get bot link status for the authenticated user
get.description: Returns link status, provider, masked chat ID, and link expiry for all linked chats.
Returns paginated audit entries showing all link actions for the tenant. Query params: `page` (int, default 1), `pageSize` (int, default 20, max 100), `action` (optional filter).

delete.summary: Unlink all bot conversations for the authenticated user
delete.description: Clears the user link on all bot conversations, downgrades command menus, and writes audit log entries.
